writers.bio: Matthias Ashmoor runs the Ashforge, a smithy that makes adventures, maps, and monsters to order for any party that can pay. The best ideas at his anvil come from the far plane, where whole worlds of mortals sit around tables and play at being us. On this desk he reports it straight, under real names, because over there those names are real.
